title: Code Garage pins (lock/pins.yaml)
description: One pinned commit per GitHub resource, keyed by the resource id (normalised URL). Machine-written by `garage pin`. Non-GitHub resources have no pin (policy link is implied).

repo.description: owner/name as GitHub names it at pin time

sha.description: full commit id, reachable from upstream's default branch

path.description: sub-folder or file inside the repo that matters, '' = the whole repo

license_at_pin.description: GitHub's SPDX id at pin time (none, NOASSERTION, OTHER possible)

size_kb.description: GitHub diskUsage in KB (history included): a coarse giant-repo signal

policy.description: snapshot = the pinned tree (or only path); readme = README + docs/ (<= 5 MB); link = nothing local
